name: The Determined Ones
source:
After graduation, Tuff is abducted and forced into the UNDERDOG GAME, a daily death challenge until only one remains. With friends and foes intertwined, can he survive the deadly trials or will someone else seize victory?

[From [url=https://horrorbox.itch.io/the-determined-ones]Itch.io[/url]]
